project_name: Last Z Hood - Docs Drop-in Integration

design_philosophy.core_principle: Minimal preservation & seamless integration. Maintain existing survival/gaming theme and existing wallet/auth features while introducing the /docs route and Docs buttons smoothly.
anti_patterns: No radical layout overhauls or changing existing HUD/StartScreen styles.
Do not replace App.js/StartScreen.jsx completely from stale ZIP copies.
Do not obscure essential navigation or wallet controls.

typography.code_font: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wide

header_navigation.desktop: Include Docs navigation link next to standard upper nav controls.
header_navigation.start_screen: Add a dedicated standard styled button 'Docs' or 'Field Guide' on StartScreen pointing to /docs.
header_navigation.docs_page: In DocsPage, preserve left sidebar chapter navigation, top search bar, and main chapter viewport.

responsive_rules.mobile: Provide mobile-friendly chapter selection dialog/drawer on /docs route.
responsive_rules.max_heights: Ensure long document scrollable area does not break main viewport.

features: Deep linking via chapter queries or URL hashes

StartScreen.guidelines: Add Docs entry button while maintaining current background, wallet login, and game entry workflow.

instructions_to_main_agent: The user's uploaded DocsPage.css is authoritative for visual design: keep its Barlow/Barlow Condensed/JetBrains Mono fonts and olive/ink/coral palette, not the generic typography/color suggestions above. Preserve the uploaded English content.
Ensure DocsPage.jsx and DocsPage.css are cleanly placed in frontend/src/components/
Add route /docs in App.js without breaking wallet authorization or existing routes
Add Docs links on upper nav bar and StartScreen landing area
Preserve existing StartScreen wallet logic and main game layout
